text: The Nasdaq Composite fell as much as 4.6% during the day before closing down 0.62% at 23,585.80; the S&P 500 ended down 0.25% and the Dow rose 0.33%.
Nvidia, down more than 9% at one point, closed 3.9% lower at $149.30, and the VIX closed up 7.3% at 28.29 after topping 30.
Gold and silver reversed steep morning losses in late US trading as Treasury yields fell and stocks rebounded; silver ended near $41.12.
GDX closed up 3.5% at $73.89 and GDXJ up 4.2% at $87.66, while GDXU jumped 10.8% to $49.32.
The 10-year Treasury yield fell about 6 bp to 4.85% as investors bought bonds despite core PCE inflation rising to 3.3%.
Brent rose 3.5% to $94.61 after Yemen's Houthis said they attacked a Saudi refinery.
QQQ closed down 0.65% at $633.93, far above its morning low, with TQQQ down about 2% and SQQQ up about 2%.
